# Regenerate (`spells:regenerate`)
**Level 7 [Transmutation](../magic-schools/transmutation.md)** | **Casting Time:** 1 minute | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S, M (a prayer wheel) | **Duration:** 1 hour | **Classes:** [Bard](../classes/bard.md), [Cleric](../classes/cleric.md), [Druid](../classes/druid.md)

A creature you touch regains 4d8 + 15 Hit Points. For the duration, the target regains 1 Hit Point at the start of each of its turns, and any severed body parts regrow after 2 minutes.
